static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;not yet接受过心理治疗;既往not yet在Work中出现过同样强烈的Fear
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑连贯,情绪明显Anxiety与担忧;倾向灾难化,读心术,预测not yet来,negate正向与过度概括;Skeptical attitude toward change但愿意尝试,合作度尚可;在谈及上级评价时语气消极,防御性较强

basic_info.main_problem: 我最近开始了一份新Work,但我not断感觉上司会讨厌我,这一信念在入职后not久就出现,并带来显著压力.
basic_info.core_demands: 害怕被上司not喜欢正在影响我的Work表现和整体身心健康,因此来寻求咨询.
growth_experiences: 来访者将当前Fear归因为以往与权威人物的not良经历('我过去遇到过一些糟糕的老板').尽管其自述以往Work中not yet出现过与当前同等强度的Fear,但对权威/上级评价的敏感性由此形成:在收到批评或建设性反馈时更易将其理解为对能力与价值的全面negate,并迅速引发对被讨厌与被解雇的担心.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / incompetent.
如果他人(尤其是上级)not喜欢我,我就会被negate和抛弃.

special_situations.event: After starting the job, received constructive feedback from the supervisor over a small mistake
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我犯错,就说明我not称职,他们会后悔雇用我并最终淘汰我.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过度Self-monitoring,尽量避免再犯错;回避与上司接触以降低被批评的可能.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们一定觉得I am very incompetent,雇我是个错误,我会被解雇.

special_situations.event: 每天上下班前后Being alone时,预演Interacting with supervisor并担心即将发生的交流
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果上司have not持续的正面反馈,就代表他们在not满或not喜欢我;负面结果迟早会发生.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Thinking over details repeatedly, intensifying worry in order to 'be prepared'; reducing communication with the supervisor and colleagues.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He / she will sooner or later hate me; something will definitely go wrong next.

special_situations.event: After completing work, receives positive recognition from supervisors or colleagues
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的肯定只是礼貌,not代表真实评价;一旦我出错,一切正面都not算数.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate正向反馈,只关注自身not足和可能的错误.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些夸奖not算数,他们只是出于礼貌.

special_situations.event: Needs face-to-face communication with the boss or to arrange a report
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要近距离接触,上司就会发现我的not足并更加not满,后果会很糟糕.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids the supervisor, delays communication, reduces exposure.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If we meet, they will pick faults with me, and things will get worse and worse.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted by superiors, to have a stable and secure work relationship.
core_conflict.fear: Fears being rejected, humiliated, or abandoned by authority, ultimately losing position and a sense of value.
defense_goal: 通过与上司保持距离以避免被negate和伤害
通过过度Self-monitoring与自我批评来预防错误,降低风险

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的,随时会失败的下属
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔,容易失望且随时可能negate人的上司/权威

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor gives affirmation or proposes steps and suggestions for change
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 下意识认为他人的肯定'只是礼貌',改变'很可能without效',类似于过去被权威negate的Anticipation在咨询关系中再现(移情).
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以犹疑,保留的语气回应,频繁use'但是/也许/我not确定'等词,语速放缓,减少自我暴露,避免明确承诺.

manifestations: At work, distances from colleagues out of fear of being disliked by the boss, reducing interaction
虽然有朋友与家人可谈,但not yet分享具体Fear,选择独自承受
将注意力集中于自我not足与他人可能的负面评价,形成内在隔离感

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在会谈中多次表达'我可以试试,但可能not用',对改变持保留态度
Excessively focusing on whether I will make mistakes, expressing cautiously and avoiding commitments

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Interprets the supervisor's positive feedback as 'just being polite' rather than genuine recognition
在咨询中倾向把内在的not安全感归结为他人not喜欢自己

exception_events.target_problem: 在Interacting with supervisor或完成任务后,来访者通常会认为上司not喜欢自己,并因此Avoids communication,反复担忧.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在完成某些任务后曾获得上司的肯定或认可,客观上出现了积极反馈,与其'必然被讨厌'的Anticipationnot同.
exception_events.reason: not同情境/支持:任务完成质量较高且得到具体肯定,客观证据短暂支持其胜任感.

positive_force: Has some competence and has received the boss's affirmation
Able to notice own negative thinking patterns and willing to try changing
Having a certain social support system (friends and family to communicate with)
negative_force: 灾难化,读心术,预测not yet来,negate正向与过度概括等认知偏差显著
对权威的负面期待与过往not良经历的影响
Avoids the boss and colleagues, forming a negative maintenance cycle
Sleep and diet affected,进一步降低情绪与Work状态

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding contact and communication with the boss
antecedent: Making mistakes at work or receiving constructive feedback
Situations requiring arranging a report or face-to-face communication with a supervisor
Before and after commuting, repeatedly worries about upcoming interactions
target_behavior.core_reason: 受过往权威负面经历影响,结合灾难化,读心术与预测not yet来的认知偏差,将反馈等同于全面negate与即将被解雇.
target_behavior.function: 逃避被批评/被negate以暂时降低Anxiety与not适.
target_behavior.consequence: 人际疏远,Anxiety worsened,Decline in work performance,进一步Reinforcement'被讨厌'的信念.

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent worry and disturbed physiological functioning (sleep and eating)
antecedent: 在Being alone时反复思考上司对自身的评价
Recalls mistakes at work or upcoming evaluations/feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: 通过担忧与反复思考试图预测与控制not yet来,以缓解not确定性所致的Anxiety(预测not yet来,情绪化推理).
target_behavior.function: Tries to gain a sense of control and safety (a failed attempt at self-soothing).
target_behavior.consequence: Physical and mental exhaustion, decreased emotional tolerance, impaired attention, further affecting work and socializing.
